See Our Projects Contact us Facebook Youtube Luxury Custom Pools For Longview, Tyler, and DFW 1917 E US-80 White Oak, TX 75693 Click Image or Find Link in Financing Built To Perfection. Built To Last Custom Gunite Pools Created Directly From Your Imagination. At Blue Canyon Pools, we pride ourselves on exceptional craftsmanship in every custom gunite pool we build. With attention to detail and the highest quality materials, we create pools that are as strong as they are beautiful. About Every Detail Matters. Why Choose Us? Building Planning The Average Project Time From Start To Finish is 6 Weeks. Award Winning Our Designs and Builds Have Won Multiple Awards. Materials Blue Canyon Pools uses top-quality materials, including durable gunite for the shell, natural rock for water features, premium tiles for detail, and high-grade plaster for a smooth, long-lasting finish. Trusted Contractors We've had a trusted relationship with all of our contractors for 15+ years. Our Stone Is Superior. Our pool coping stones are thicker and more durable than those of our competitors because we prioritize high-quality, dense natural stone and cut it to a greater thickness, 3 to 3.5 Inches. We Pride ourselves on our stone. We buy our stone directly from the best quarries located in Arkansas, Oklahoma, and Tennessee ensuring exceptional quality product. Our stone’s thickness is almost double all of our competitor’s . This extra thickness not only enhances the stone’s strength but also makes it more resistant to cracking, chipping, and wear over time, even in harsh conditions. The superior material ensures the coping maintains its integrity and appearance for much longer than thinner alternatives. Additionally, our precise craftsmanship guarantees consistent quality, creating a seamless fit and improved overall durability. With these factors combined, our pool coping stones offer greater longevity, making them a more reliable and cost-effective choice for pool owners. Project Time Start To Finish: 6 Weeks Blue Canyon Pools We build custom in-ground swimming pools and spas that will blow you out of the water. go with us and we can turn your backyard into an outdoor living and entertainment area. Choose Blue Canyon Pools for quality, fast service, and expert craftsmanship—your dream pool, done right. reviews.text: We tried 2 other pool companies and they were not responsive with emails and calls and we reached out to Blue Canyon after a friends recommendation! Heath came to our house the same day we called. Heath listened to our ideas and brought our vision to life! Heath has been wonderful from planning, to installation and any follow up questions after completion. We could not be happier with Heath and his crew at Blue Canyon Pools!!! Lance and I highly recommend!! 5 stars!
reviews.author: Vickie Hale

reviews.text: Blue canyon is wonderful to work with. It was an extremely smooth process. Heath always answers his phone and is happy to answer questions.They were careful with our yard and the pool turned iut amazing
reviews.author: erin smith

reviews.text: I have had three pools done now and I finally got it right with Blue Canyon. Blue Canyon is extremely professional and their communication is top notch. If you are thinking about building a new pool, blue Canyon is the right choice.
reviews.author: Jeff Tucker

reviews.text: I can’t tell you how thrilled we are to have our new pool up and running !  When we first met with Heath he set the expectations and told us why he is different than the competition.   Some may call it salesmanship slick talking, I call it confidence.  The man knows what he’s talking about and knows how to deliver on promises.  Heath told me early on that he will always answer his phone and if he can’t he calls back quickly.  He one hundred percent kept his word.  Some of the local competitors wouldn’t even call me back for bids.  I don’t know how they are in business.  Anyways the pool is beautiful took less than four weeks to complete.  I could not sing his praises enough.   His whole team was so awesome at no point did we ever feel uncomfortable or not appreciated.  Thank you all for our wonderful  pool !  You guys rock.
reviews.author: Casey J

reviews.text: We can’t thank Heath, Jordan, and Koltyn with Blue Canyon enough for working with us to make a dream of ours come true. We started our build on June 18th and had our first family swim on July 13th!! Just because our pool is done, that doesn’t mean their communication has stopped which was a huge concern of ours. We have been so impressed with their continued updates throughout this process. If anyone is on the fence about which company to use, I highly recommend Blue Canyon!
reviews.author: Krystle J

reviews.text: Blue Canyon Pools is amazing! Heath was so friendly and helped us get exactly what we wanted! We have had our pool for almost 7 years and we have zero complaints!! Blue Canyon builds beautiful high-quality pools and stands behind their work!
reviews.author: Stephen Harms

reviews.text: Blue Canyon pools are second to none. We just built our third swimming pool with this company. Heath was amazing and we loved working with them! They always follow up and produce a quality swimming pool every-time!!!!
reviews.author: Shaun Baker

reviews.text: Blue Canyon exceeded our expectations. Our pool turned out exactly as we wanted.  They were on time and on budget. They were very tidy as they worked and left the job site clean after completion. Heath was direct and easy to work with throughout the process.  I highly recommend. - Rusty Dunavant
reviews.author: T D

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. They contain specific details, varied writing styles, and consistent praise for communication and project execution. There are no discernible complaint patterns or red flags. The ratings are consistent across platforms.
authentic_signals: Specific details (project timelines, crew names like Heath, Jordan, Koltyn)
Mention of prior negative experiences with competitors
Consistent praise for communication and professionalism
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are highly consistent across Google (4.7) and Yelp (4.7). The BBB A+ rating indicates good complaint handling. The low-rating HQ Google listing is permanently closed and has only 2 old reviews, so it is not a relevant discrepancy for the active business.
